name: blast-voxel-fragmentation
description: Visual verification of voxel fragmentation: before/after terrain, crater formation, bench levels, isolated islands

steps.description: Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole. Cash bumped to $400,000: this file's 16-hole grid is a heavier workload than most (a single driller/drill_rig lands roughly one hole every 15 ticks door-to-door at this tight spacing), and every hole must actually land before charging — a partially-drilled 4x4 pattern would corrupt the crater/island physics this file exists to visualize — so headroom matters more than usual (no income anywhere in this file).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:4 cols:4 spacing:2 depth:6 start:14,14
steps.description: One decrement click on the spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") lowers it 3->2m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts) before dragging, so the (14,14)-(20,20) rectangle computes the declared 4x4. #553: spacing tightened from the original 4m (1 increment click) to 2m (1 decrement) to keep this 16-hole grid's total drilling time inside a single driller/drill_rig's practical workday — sandbox-measured, 16 holes at spacing 4 push the crew into a genuine worker_revolt (WorkerRevolt.ts: wellBeing pinned at 0 for REVOLT_TICKS=120) around tick 400 regardless of cash on hand, since one employee cannot both drill nonstop that long and rest enough; at spacing 2 they land by tick 244 with over $300,000 still in hand. depth corrected from 8 to 6 (Ground rule #15/Finding #42's class, the whole-suite audit before Phase 3): this step never clicks the grid tool's depth stepper (data-field="depth"), so the real drag always produces the panel's own 6m default regardless of what's declared. This file's own expect blocks only assert hole/charge/sequence counts around the affected blast (depth-insensitive), so this is a metadata-only correction -- verified both modes still pass unchanged.

expect.note: 4 rows x 4 cols = 16 holes ordered (ghosts), none drilled yet (#553)

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — every hole must actually land before charging (a partially-drilled pattern would corrupt the physics this file exists to visualize). Sandbox-measured landing at tick 244.

expect.note: All 16 holes have landed — none lost, none left ordered forever.

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero
